articles.title: GHSA: Ghost: Stored XSS via Embed Card Previews
articles.summary:
### Impact

Embed cards in the Ghost editor could be used to bypass the fix for GHSA-8vhf-xxpj-4qrg. Any staff user, including Contributors, could store scripts in post content that ran when another staff user opened the post in the editor, possibly resulting in compromise of that user's admin session.

Self-hosted sites should leave the new `security.embedPreviewUrl` config option at its default.

articles.title: GHSA: Docling: Crafted DoclingDocument JSON embeds local image files into converted output
articles.summary:
### Summary

docling accepts serialized `DoclingDocument` JSON as an input format (`InputFormat.JSON_DOCLING`, enabled by default). A crafted JSON file can set a picture's image `uri` to a local file path. A few bytes of input, such as `<td rowspan="100000000">`, make docling run loops proportional to the declared span and allocate a table grid of the declared size. The result is CPU and memory exhaustion.
